name: mcp-kanban
description: MCP server for a kanban task board and project board. A task board per project that hands off to the time tracker.

settings.name: mcp.zovo.one token
settings.description: A free anonymous token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token, or your Pro key. One token is one data space, and it is refreshed for another 30 days on every write.

kanban.description: A task board per project that hands off to the time tracker.
